files.rationale: Error-impact ladder; each level describes observable frequency and effect of grammar, spelling and punctuation errors together with vocabulary range.
Rubric-fit ladder; each level states how many of the three rubric requirements (vocabulary, grammar, mechanics) are met and how fully.
Reader-experience ladder; levels describe what a reader observes (comprehension effort, noticeable errors, word choice), with the boundary between levels stated in each description.
Single score whose nine levels each describe an observable language situation (error frequency and effect on meaning, vocabulary range), anchored to the rubric wording at 1.0, 3.0 and 5.0.
Coarse-to-fine hierarchy; choose a band (low, middle, high) by error impact, then a fine choice inside that band with contrastive criteria.
Branch cascade of atomic true/false statements about error impact and vocabulary, descending from the top label.
